fields.climate: temperate; cool summers and mild winters; overcast about a third of the time
fields.terrain: hills in north and south bisected by central valley
fields.hazards: occasional high winds and rough seas
fields.farm: cereals, vegetables; cattle, sheep, pigs, poultry
fields.exports: crude petroleum, artwork, vegetables, fruits, whiskies
fields.languages: English, Manx Gaelic (about 2% of the population has some knowledge)
fields.religions: Christian 54.7%, Muslim 0.5%, Buddhist 0.5%, Hindu 0.4%, Jewish 0.2%, none 43.8%
fields.legal: UK laws apply, as well as Manx statutes
